description: 100-V three-phase BLDC gate driver, DRV8300D variant with integrated bootstrap diodes, VQFN-24 with adjustable deadtime (DT pin) and MODE pin.

pinout.name: INLA
pinout.notes: Low-side gate driver control input for phase A.

pinout.name: INLB
pinout.notes: Low-side gate driver control input for phase B.

pinout.name: INLC
pinout.notes: Low-side gate driver control input for phase C.

pinout.name: GVDD
pinout.notes: Gate driver power supply input. Connect an X5R or X7R, GVDD-rated ceramic >=10uF local capacitance between GVDD and GND.

pinout.name: MODE
pinout.notes: Controls GLx polarity vs INLx: floating = non-inverted, tied to GVDD = inverted.

pinout.name: GND
pinout.notes: Device ground.

pinout.name: NC
pinout.notes: No internal connection; can float or tie to system ground.

pinout.name: NC
pinout.notes: No internal connection; can float or tie to system ground.

pinout.name: GLB
pinout.notes: Low-side gate driver output, phase B. Connect to low-side MOSFET gate.

pinout.name: GLA
pinout.notes: Low-side gate driver output, phase A. Connect to low-side MOSFET gate.

pinout.name: SHC
pinout.notes: High-side source sense input, phase C. Connect to high-side MOSFET source.

pinout.name: GHC
pinout.notes: High-side gate driver output, phase C. Connect to high-side MOSFET gate.

pinout.name: BSTC

pinout.name: SHB
pinout.notes: High-side source sense input, phase B. Connect to high-side MOSFET source.

pinout.name: GHB
pinout.notes: High-side gate driver output, phase B. Connect to high-side MOSFET gate.

pinout.name: BSTB
pinout.notes: Bootstrap output, phase B. Connect capacitor between BSTB and SHB.

pinout.name: SHA
pinout.notes: High-side source sense input, phase A. Connect to high-side MOSFET source.

pinout.name: GHA
pinout.notes: High-side gate driver output, phase A. Connect to high-side MOSFET gate.

pinout.name: BSTA
pinout.notes: Bootstrap output, phase A. Connect capacitor between BSTA and SHA.

pinout.name: DT
pinout.notes: Deadtime input. Resistor to GND sets variable deadtime; floating gives fixed deadtime (QFN variant only).

pinout.name: INHA
pinout.notes: High-side gate driver control input, phase A.

pinout.name: INHB
pinout.notes: High-side gate driver control input, phase B.

pinout.name: INHC
pinout.notes: High-side gate driver control input, phase C.

pinout.name: PowerPAD
pinout.notes: Exposed thermal pad. Datasheet states it must be soldered to the PCB for thermal and mechanical performance; net connection (e.g. to GND) is not stated in the text extracted here.

decoupling.notes: Low ESR/ESL capacitor required to support high peak currents drawn from GVDD during external MOSFET turn-on.
Bootstrap capacitor between BSTx and SHx; low ESR/ESL, sized to support high peak turn-on currents. Repeat per phase (BSTB-SHB, BSTC-SHC).
Same bootstrap capacitor requirement as BSTA-SHA.
Same bootstrap capacitor requirement as BSTA-SHA.

land_pattern.package: RGE0024B, VQFN 24-pin, 1mm max height, 4.0mm x 4.0mm body
land_pattern.notes: Perimeter pads 24x(0.25 x 0.6mm) at 0.5mm pitch on a 3.8mm x 3.8mm span (IPC land pattern, non-solder-mask-defined preferred). Exposed thermal pad is pad 25, nominal 2.45mm square (package outline), with an optional 20x via array (0.5mm pitch) under the pad per TI's example board layout; TI recommends vias under paste be filled, plugged, or tented. pad_count counts the exposed pad (pad 25), as the footprint does.

layout_notes: Low ESR/ESL capacitors must be connected close to the device between GVDD/GND and between each BSTx/SHx pair to support high peak currents during external MOSFET turn-on.
A low ESR electrolytic capacitor plus a good-quality ceramic capacitor should be connected between the high-side MOSFET drain and ground to limit voltage transients.
Minimize parasitic inductance between high-side and low-side MOSFET sources to avoid large negative SHx transients.
Minimize trace length and via count on GHx, SHx, GLx connections; minimum 10 mil, typical 15 mil trace width recommended.
Place the DT resistor to GND as close as possible to the device.
Place the gate driver as close to the MOSFETs as possible to confine high peak gate charge/discharge currents to a minimal area, reducing loop inductance and gate-terminal noise.
On QFN package variants, NC pins (7, 8) can be tied to GND to increase the ground connection between the thermal pad and the external ground plane.
The exposed thermal pad must be soldered to the PCB for thermal and mechanical performance (package outline note); vias under the pad are optional per application.

abs_max.param: GHx with respect to SHx (500ns transient)
